Column identity checks: dept rows sum EXACTLY to published Total Net Appropriations 4,421,957,497 (delta=0) and each fund column sums exactly to its printed total (GF 1,747,988,155; Grants 152,092,816; Special Revenue 364,090,706; Debt Service 418,969,881; Trust & Agency 326,969; Enterprise 325,500,459; Capital 1,412,988,511; Internal Service 705,186,468; Transfers 344,784,523). Note: ~15 rows do not foot internally against the 5 gov-fund cols (e.g., Finance 18,897,406 vs gov-col sum 33,267,555; ITS 45,907,000 vs 140,907,971; B&ES 7,416,395 vs 148,890,223), and the printed row D equals B+C+IS for all rows; the gov-col vs B gap appears to be book-internal presentation in the published table, not extraction error (verified against printed page image and token x-coordinates). Rows include non-department lines: Non-Departmental/Non-Operating, Contribution to Other Agencies, Other Funds, Debt Service, Self-Insurance (all-null). File hash of source used: sha1 of the 33,879,191-byte download already fetched 2026-11-21; verified identical size via HTTP HEAD on sa.gov URL.
honest_gaps: Self-Insurance row is all-null in published table (0 across gov/enterprise/capital). 15 rows whose published gov-fund columns do not sum to their all-funds total are recorded as printed (see notes). Intsvc-only rows (Self-Insurance internal service 342,508,175) not attributable to any department row D.

Fund-type column totals also match exactly: GF 1,646,663,618; Special Revenue 381,873,597; Capital 350,361,446; Enterprise 535,161,017; Internal Service 369,513,892; Pension Trust 25,409,076. Source PDF verified as "FY25-26 Annual Budget - Adopted" (Content-Length 12,439,048 = byte-identical to the local 672-page file). Note: "Investigations Homeland Security", "Parks, Recreation Community Services", "Patrol Enforcement", "Personnel Professional Standards" names had &-ampersands stripped during word grouping; these are JSOsheriff subunits/department names as printed. Dept total includes negative line: Jax Citywide Activities carries (1,130,490) in Internal Service within its 514,513,370 all-funds total. Published citywide net budget is 3,516,195,862 incl. fund-to-fund adjustments; the schedule here excludes transfers and nets to 3,308,982,646.
honest_gaps: Sheriff function is split into Executive Office of the Sheriff + Patrol & Enforcement + Investigations Homeland Security + Personnel & Professional Standards as separate budget-department rows (as published). source_url: City of Austin FY 2025-26 Approved Budget (local PDF fetched 2026-11-21 as %TEMP%/ps_budget/austin_approved.pdf, 1,371 pp; producer Adobe Acrobat 25.1 / Ghostscript; the prior night fetch of austin_fy26.pdf was a 166KB stub/summary)
source_pages: Per-department "Expenditure by Funds > Total by Funds" rows in the Departments section. Per-dept PDF page indices: Animal Services 154, Arts/Culture/Music/Ent 161, Austin Convention Center 174, Austin Energy 185, Austin Resource Recovery 201, Austin Water 213, Aviation 230, Capital Delivery Services 241, City Attorney 254, City Auditor 261, City Clerk 266, Development Services 272, Economic Development 286, EMS 305, Facilities Mgmt 320, Financial Services 333, Fire 350, Fleet Mobility 362, Forensic Science 373, Homeless Strategies 378, Housing 389, Human Resources 401, Management Services 414, Mayor & Council 429, Municipal Court 435, Parks & Recreation 445, Planning 460, Police 469, Public Health 483, Public Library 496, SMBR 506, Technology Services 512, Transportation & Public Works 524, Watershed Protection 560
extraction_notes: FY 2025-26 column = 'Approved' (the 2025-26 Adopted budget; 2024-25 Amended and 2026-27 Planned columns present for context but not extracted as the headline number). Numbers are ALL-FUNDS department totals (sum of the department's funds as printed on the 'Total by Funds' row). All-funds identity: dept sum 7,089,913,688 exceeds the city's all-funds expenditure-by-fund-category table (p.596-597: Total Requirements 8,449,741 thousand incl. Debt Retirement 843,485K and reserve funds 260,452K not in dept pages; net requirements 6,344,246K) - dept pages exclude debt service funds and reserve funds, and include enterprise gross billings; so no direct published all-funds grand-total match is possible at dept grain. General Fund citywide FY2025-26 = 1,579,157 (thousand) per p.595 table. Anomalies caught and fixed during extraction: pypdf column misassignment on multi-fund pages (Aviation, Economic Development, Human Resources, SMBR, Technology Services, Watershed, ARTS, Facilities, Mgmt Svcs) - resolved by pdfplumber re-extraction with page-range + label-anchored parsing; per-page department-title identity check passed for all 34 sections. Police figure is General Fund-heavy (527,940,862 all-funds incl. asset forfeiture/seizure funds). 'Austin Water' total 881,711,491 excludes the Wildland Conservation 285,000 - no: includes (verified identity sum). Human Resources 385,874,635 is mostly Employee Benefits Fund (self-insurance) - an intergovernmental passthrough-like pool.
honest_gaps: No dept-grain citywide all-funds reconciliation total published anywhere in the book (the All Funds Summary is by fund category only), so a delta-0 grand-total check is not possible; instead every row carries its own fund-level addition identity as printed. Debt Service/Debt Retirement funds and reserve funds have no department sections, so they are outside the 7,089,913,688 dept sum. 'Budget & Organizational Excellence', 'Communications & Engagement', 'Climate Action & Resilience', 'Equity & Inclusion', 'Government Relations', 'Police Oversight' offices listed on the departments page are budgeted within Management Services/City Manager sections and are not separate sections in the book.

source_pages: CSV: 80 dept groupings x program x expense-category rows, FY27 Budget column, citywide footer row. Cross-check PDF: Volume I pp. 73-76 (PDF indices 39-42), Table 7: All Funds Budgets
extraction_notes: Published FY27 ADOPTED budget from the city's own open-data CSV (dataset 'operating-budget', FY27 adopted). DELTA CHECK: sum of 81 dept rows = 4,942,387,983 vs published citywide footer row 4,942,387,983.36 -> delta = -0.05 USD (rounding), GOLD. CSV totals are GENERAL FUND operating budget (Table 7 cross-check: several dept GF values match Table 7 to the dollar: Mayor Office 6,487,124 / Law 10,854,659 / Office of Equity 3,363,345 / Police 484,521,843 / Fire 336,556,974 / Public Health 148,424,838). Table 7 adds External Funds (558,708,056) and Capital (599,157,439) for a 4,871,576,783 all-funds total; grant/capital splits by dept live in Volumes II-III and are NOT included in these dept rows. 101 program/expense-category cells are #Missing in the CSV (zero-effect rows suppressed) and 4 blank rows skipped; per-dept sums still reconcile to the citywide footer. Central/undistributed GF budgets (Pensions 443,031,667; Debt Service 296,885,354; Health Insurance 295,162,265; Charter School Tuition 306,211,332; MBTA 103,084,257; Medicare 17M; OPEB 40M; Snow 22,676,037; reserves) are carried as their own rows as published. Table 7 also reconciles: GF col 3,713,711,288 + Ext 558,708,056 + Capital 599,157,439 = 4,871,576,783 (delta 0 internally).
honest_gaps: Dept rows are GF-only; External Funds and Capital Fund amounts by dept (Table 7 cols 2-3) not merged into the dept totals in this line (they are listed in source_pages for follow-up). One CSV dept row is an empty-string header artifact (excluded). #Missing cells (~101 of 922) are 0-contribution line items; treating them as 0 reconciles exactly, so confidence is high but strictly they are suppressed values.
